sections.section_content:
The NAND controller must wait for RNB to be asserted low before sending its next
command (see Figure181). This timing constraint is set according to tWB using
MEMHOLD[7:0] bitfield in FMC_PMEM or ATTHOLD[7:0] in FMC_PATT.
[Figure 181. Access to NAND flash memory]
1. NCE can be deasserted for NAND flash memories since CE is don't care except for very old NAND flash
devices that are not considered in this example.

Any CPU read or write access to the NAND flash memory has a delay of
(MEMHOLD[7:0]+1)*fmc_ker_ck cycles after the NWE signal is asserted.
The ATTHOLD[7:0] bitfield in FMC_PATT register must be determined to satisfy tWB timing
constraints and selectively apply larger timing constraints to the last command or address
byte in CPU mode. When setting ATTHOLD[7:0], the 2*fmc_ker_ck delay required for the
sampling of RNB by NAND sequencer must also taken into account.
